notes.headline: Work on your characters anywhere, with fewer snags
notes.intro: PixelDoll now fits into your routine more easily, whether you're on a phone, offline or bringing in characters from elsewhere. Dressing up your characters should feel smoother from start to finish.

highlights.title: Install Studio and use it offline
highlights.text: You can now install PixelDoll as an app and open Studio without a connection. Updates are checked while you work and applied safely at startup without getting in your way.

highlights.title: Import characters by dropping a ZIP
highlights.text: A new drop area lets you bring in a character from a ZIP file. You can also pick moves across a PixelLab character's different states.

highlights.title: Watch item thumbnails fit progressively
highlights.text: Items now show progressive fitted thumbnails while they are made, so you can see your design take shape. Standing designs are generated before the moves you choose.

highlights.title: Step through frames, go full screen
highlights.text: Studio now has visible frame stepping so you can check animations one frame at a time. A new full screen toggle gives your artwork more room.

fixes.text: Navigation is no longer covered on short phone screens.
Dialogs no longer close by accident after you drag inside them.
Move names are easier to read and preview menus stay in place.

notes.banner: In a bright costume shop filled with afternoon sun, a young tailor with curly silver hair fits a rose-pink velvet coat onto a mannequin beside shelves of boots and gloves.
